external_primary_sources.title: Memristor—The Missing Circuit Element
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Historical definition of the ideal electrical memristor as a charge-flux constitutive element.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: Does not establish a CAS charge-flux mapping, cognitive memory, software implementation, or physical CAS device.

external_primary_sources.title: Memristive Devices and Systems
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: General electrical internal-state formulation for memristive systems and distinction from the ideal element.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: Does not make every history-dependent mathematical or software system an electrical memristive system.

external_primary_sources.title: The Missing Memristor Found
external_primary_sources.narrow_use: Example of a reported physical nanoscale model and device interpretation, used to distinguish physical-device evidence from equations and software.
external_primary_sources.non_inference: Does not establish a physical CAS component, validate all memristor models, or transfer the reported material behavior to software.

external_primary_sources.title: Erratum: The Missing Memristor Found
